MIRRORSee how you actually use your phoneMirror shows the quality of your attention, not just the hours. It runs on this device and never asks you to log anything by hand.

J9 · Focus windows

Focus never blocks or shames; it repeats the choice you made.

tier DP3all states →

9:41▮▮▮ ⌁
Focus windowsYou choose; Mirror only reminds you of your own choice
Scheduledlocal notifications only
Weekday deep workAnnounces at the start; never counts down, never nags.
09:00–11:30
Quiet hoursNotifications are suppressed; collection continues locally.
22:30–07:00
How it behaves
A focus window does not block apps and does not shame you when you leave it. It shows one line when you return and nothing else. You can delete the window in one tap.
Focus windows are tier D only: they need nothing but timestamps, and work with no network and no account.

Today · Private1h 16m
Private widget: shows totals only, never which app or what you read.
No public widget · Private—A public widget needs topic data (A/B/C). With usage data only, Mirror shows nothing here rather than inventing it.
Widgets are rendered by the OS, which can show them on a lock screen. That is why the private widget shows totals and no titles, and why a public widget can only exist from topics you published yourself.
